_note: Where each library still's subject sits, as fractions of the still (x0, y0, x1, y1) and its pixel size. blender_reenact.py maps the box through the cut-back view's starting kb, as render.py crops it, and warns when the reenactment's first frame differs by more than 0.06 in x-centre or 12% in height. Measure a new still once, by eye or with a box tool, and add it here; derived stills (DERIVED_STILLS) use their source's box.
